title: PRIMORDIAL REMASTERED v3.0 FULL AUTOFARM AND AUTO COMBO
features:
⚡ The #1 Auto Farm Script for The Strongest Battlegrounds ⚡
🔥 FEATURES 🔥

🎯 AUTO FARM (MAIN FEATURE)

🤖 Full auto combat — teleports to enemies & attacks automatically
💥 Uses Communicate:FireServer for REAL damage (server-side hits)
🎯 Auto-target nearest player OR lowest HP
🔄 Auto-retargets when enemy dies — farms the WHOLE server
📍 Every-frame teleport tracking — never lose your target
🛡️ Auto Block — blocks when enemies get close
💪 Auto Serious Mode (G) — activates awakening automatically
💀 Kill counter — track your kills

👊 STRONGEST HERO (SAITAMA) COMBOS

⚡ 5 combo presets: Quick, Basic, Advanced, OneShot, Pro (Wiki)
🔢 Abilities 1-2-3-4 + G fully supported
🏃 Dash chaining (Q) between combos
⏱️ Adjustable M1 speed & delayed M1 for stun extension

👁️ ESP & VISUALS

📛 Player nametags with health bars
✨ Highlight outlines on all players
🔲 Bounding boxes option

🛡️ PROTECTION

🚫 Anti-AFK (never get kicked)
🛡️ Anti-Fling (blocks fling attacks)
💪 Anti-Ragdoll (prevents stuns)
⬆️ Anti-Void (teleports you back if you fall)
🏥 Auto Escape — TPs to spawn at low HP (adjustable 5-80%)
🔄 Auto Respawn on death

🚀 MOVEMENT & EXPLOITS

🏃 Walk Speed (16-200)
🦘 Jump Power (50-300)
👻 NoClip — walk through walls
✈️ Fly — WASD + Space/Shift
💨 CFrame Speed

📍 TELEPORTS

🎯 TP to Target
🎲 TP to Random Player
🏠 TP to Spawn

💣 FLING

🌀 Fling Players (touch to launch)
🎯 Fling Target (TP fling + return)
⌨️ CONTROLS
Left Ctrl — Show/Hide menu
Select target in Main tab or use Auto-Target (Nearest/Lowest HP)
Hit "Clear Target" to go back to auto mode
⚙️ HOW TO USE
🎮 Join The Strongest Battlegrounds
👊 Select Strongest Hero (Saitama) in-game
📋 Execute this script in your executor
🎯 Toggle Auto Farm or Auto Combat
💀 Watch it farm the whole server automatically!
⚠️ NOTES
👊 Combos are designed for Strongest Hero (Saitama) ONLY
🎯 Auto-targets everyone — no need to select specific players
🛡️ Turn on Anti-Void + Auto Escape for safety
💪 Works with most executors
